base_values.validation: Actual loaded numeric bytes versus every serialized cache tensor; packed QuantState JSON semantic equality; only small RMSNorm BF16-to-FP32 casts allowed

nf4_dispatch.interpretation: Installed Python forward identity; no kernel-level profiling or speedup claim

actor_learner_binding.identity_difference: Probability execution profile/runtime only; all other fields match exactly
actor_learner_binding.reference_interpretation: Actor reference probabilities are preserved as diagnostics; the KL target is a separate frozen unsloth-model-parallel learner reference forward

directional_numerics.direction: negative sign of the measured, unclipped focal objective gradient
directional_numerics.forward_mode: grad-enabled forward, immediately detached; no probe backward
directional_numerics.limitation: Finite differences in BF16 can be nonsmooth. Sign descent is not a resumed-Adam direction; no step is accepted, selected, exported or used for training.

focal_groups.action_mass_interpretation: Complete verified groups retain their action mass even when same rewards or identical sampled actions produce no preference gradient; missing/unknown partners never receive an invented reward or action count
focal_groups.objective: same-state mean-centered terminal reward; focal action only

head.limitation: Hidden states are detached for head isolation; this comparison alone does not validate the NF4 backbone backward or task learning.
head.oracle_math: FP32 blocked GEMM, highest precision, TF32 disabled; caller math restored
head.scope: At most four source-structured detached predictors per action, at most two actions/eight rows; actual RL upstream coefficients use identical selected indices. Reward is attribution metadata only; probe shape differs from the complete focal head shape

limitation: No optimizer was constructed or called. Gradient/head measurements do not establish update direction, 16K backward capacity or independent task gains. Behavior data remains unconsumed by training.

objective.action_boundary: Only naturally terminated tool_calls/stop responses; censored pairs are excluded
objective.action_reduction: Sum of mixed-group action terms divided by all complete verified group action mass; same-reward and identical-action groups retain zero-PG mass
objective.estimand: Naturally terminated verified-pair focal surrogate with fixed token scaling; action-dependent completion/verification selection and complete-group normalization can change the expected terminal-return gradient direction
objective.kl_group_scope: Only mixed distinct-action groups have k3 evaluated; zero-PG groups retain denominator mass but receive no extra KL forward/backward. This is not an all-group KL estimate.
objective.kl_reduction: sum of selected token sampled k3 terms divided by fixed_token_scale
objective.limitation: Terminal verification and valid-pair selection still restrict coverage. Sequence TIS is truncated; sampled k3 is a fixed-data regularizer. Neither mode estimates an unbiased full-trajectory task gradient or exact current-policy KL.
objective.policy_reduction: sum of selected token PPO terms divided by fixed_token_scale

groups.action_mass_interpretation: Complete verified groups retain their action mass even when same rewards or identical sampled actions produce no preference gradient; missing/unknown partners never receive an invented reward or action count
groups.objective: same-state mean-centered terminal reward; focal action only

adapter_initialization.boundary: Actual saved plain PEFT adapter, loaded without merging into NF4 base
